title: Files
description: How uploads end, which a client that sends files the API doesn't accept, or a bucket that stops answering, changes, and whether the bucket answers the API's calls (the files spec).

panels.title: How do uploads end?
panels.description: Uploads in the last 5 minutes that reached the check of their bytes, by how each ended: stored, unsupported_type, its bytes of no kind the API accepts, or failed, as when the bucket doesn't answer (FILES-013). A rise in failed beside 503s on the upload route is the bucket's.

panels.title: Does the bucket answer?
panels.description: Calls to the bucket of files' bytes in the last 5 minutes, writes, reads, deletions and listings, by how each ended: ok, not_found, failed, when the bucket refused the call or answered what the client couldn't read, or unavailable, when it didn't answer in time or answered that it can't serve now (FILES-012). Only unavailable calls, with no answered one, are the alert StorageUnreachable.
